items.text: Specifications are authoritative: docs/specs/ defines intended behaviour; if implementation reveals a spec problem or ambiguity, stop and ask the user rather than diverging, and report mismatches instead of silently weakening the spec.

Test-first, always green: write tests before implementation and keep each step green under make test (pytest via uv). Tests follow tests/T{spec}-{n}-{feature}-{name}.py, avoid network by replaying journals, and hexa-dependent tests skip when hexa is missing. Canonical test specifics live at domain/pattern:SpecExamplesAsTests.
Follow project Python style: tabs, module docstrings, types first, camelCase functions/methods/fields, PascalCase classes, UPPER_CASE constants, logical section headers, and explicit # EOF.

Organize each format as a feature package under src/py/onto/{feature}/ with model.py, parser.py, formatter.py, operations.py (operations under an Operator class holding context), and public __init__.py. Optional integrations live at src/py/onto/integrations/{name}/ and load their library only when imported. Canonical layout: domain/pattern:FeaturePackage.
